<thought>Based on the mass spectrum (m/z ≈ 183.045 [M+H]⁺) the neutral molecular formula is C10H14O3. The 13C NMR shows a carbonyl carbon (~169 ppm), six aromatic carbons (123–133 ppm), and two aliphatic carbons (≈43 ppm and ≈26 ppm). This pattern fits a benzoic acid bearing an ethyl substituent on the ring (ethyl benzoic acid). The ethyl group provides the benzylic CH₂ (≈43 ppm) and the terminal CH₃ (≈26 ppm). The SMILES for ethyl benzoic acid is:

**CCc1ccc(C(=O)O)cc1**.

This SMILES corresponds to the formula C10H14O3, matches the observed mass and the NMR carbon shifts.</thought>
<final_answer>CCc1ccc(C(=O)O)cc1</final_answer>
